verdicts.reason: A moves the headline above the watch and leaves an empty band about 100px tall at the top. It also swaps the price above the subhead and drops the logo from top-left to a small spot beside the legal text at the bottom, which weakens the brand and the original's product-then-message order. B keeps the original order of watch, headline and CTA and fills the canvas better. However, it also swaps the price and subhead, its upscaled watch looks soft and pixelated, and the CTA, demoted logo and tiny legal text are crammed together at the bottom.
